source_behavior.summary: The TaxonomyManager submit control displays Save/Saving, is disabled while saving, and submits the EditForm through SaveAsync.
source_behavior.mutation: Creates or updates the selected WordPress taxonomy term through WordPressTaxonomyWebService.
source_behavior.reconciliation: On success the source resets local edit state and reloads authoritative taxonomy terms.

laravel_adaptation.runtime_wiring: Only the taxonomy.manage ActionDialog submit is marked as AIMW-TAXO-39CDD7EF81 and presents localized Save/Saving semantics.
laravel_adaptation.submit_pipeline: ActionDialog validates the draft and ResourceContent prepares the server-advertised action contract, POSTs through apiRequest, then mutateThenReconcile requires query.refetch to succeed.
laravel_adaptation.busy_guard: The submit is disabled while mutation.isPending and exposes aria-busy.

tenant_isolation.authority: tenant and active site are supplied by authenticated server context/action-contract discovery; foreign or missing site context fails closed
tenant_isolation.payload_identity: tenant/site IDs are not accepted from user draft fields

authorization.missing_permission: taxonomy.manage contract is unavailable with permission_denied
authorization.foreign_site: taxonomy.manage contract is unavailable with context_mismatch

authoritative_state.success_rule: no success is reported until the POST completes and authoritative taxonomy re-read succeeds
authoritative_state.failure_rule: mutation or re-read failures remain error paths; no synthetic row is created
